"""Pixel-based locked camera animation of the supplied kinetic sand experiment.
No models or external imagery: all visible materials come from first_frame.png.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter, map_coordinates, binary_dilation
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix
from scipy.sparse.linalg import factorized
import artifact_io

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W,H,N,FPS = 1280,720,120,24
I = np.asarray(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'), dtype=np.float32)
rng = np.random.default_rng(1234)

# Tool contours measured from the source RGB, not from a reference mask.
left_outer = [(0,565),(15,555),(30,544),(45,537),(60,534),(75,534),(90,537),(105,541),(120,546),(135,552),(144,561),(159,567),(174,571),(183,577),(189,587)]
left_inner = [(0,653),(27,653),(30,650),(33,640),(36,625),(39,614),(42,606),(45,599),(48,594),(54,591),(60,583),(66,577),(72,573),(78,570),(84,568),(90,570),(96,575),(105,580),(114,584),(129,586),(141,586),(150,588),(162,591),(177,592),(183,592),(189,590)]
right_outer = [(0,724),(15,742),(30,754),(45,761),(60,764),(75,768),(90,773),(105,780),(120,785),(129,784),(135,778),(141,775),(146,767)]
right_inner = [(0,653),(27,653),(30,650),(33,668),(36,681),(39,693),(42,700),(45,705),(48,709),(54,717),(60,722),(66,726),(72,729),(78,732),(84,734),(90,735),(105,738),(117,741),(123,745),(129,749),(135,755),(141,763),(146,767)]

def contour_mask(outer,inner,yend):
    y,x=np.mgrid[:H,:W]
    o=np.interp(y[:,0],np.array(outer)[:,0],np.array(outer)[:,1])[:,None]
    q=np.interp(y[:,0],np.array(inner)[:,0],np.array(inner)[:,1])[:,None]
    lo=np.minimum(o,q); hi=np.maximum(o,q)
    a=np.minimum(np.clip((x-lo+2.5)/3,0,1),np.clip((hi-x+2.5)/3,0,1))
    a*=np.clip((yend+1-y)/3,0,1)
    return a.astype(np.float32)

lm=contour_mask(left_outer,left_inner,190)
rm=contour_mask(right_outer,right_inner,147)
tool_gate=np.maximum(lm,rm)
Y,X=np.mgrid[:H,:W].astype(np.float32)
# The ball is slightly vertically blurred in the source; preserve that blur.
ball_gate=np.clip((1.0-((X-680)/88)**2-((Y-202)/105)**2)*12,0,1)
ball_gate*=((Y>98)&(Y<306)).astype(np.float32)
# Smoothly reconstruct only the uncovered wall, preserving the original table.
hole=binary_dilation((tool_gate>.01)|(ball_gate>.01),iterations=5)
hole[318:]=False
coords=np.argwhere(hole)
idx=np.full((H,W),-1,np.int32)
idx[hole]=np.arange(len(coords))
rows=[];cols=[];vals=[]
rhs=np.zeros((len(coords),3),np.float64)
deg=np.zeros(len(coords),np.float64)
ys,xs=coords.T
base=np.arange(len(coords))
for dy,dx in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
    ny=ys+dy;nx=xs+dx
    valid=(ny>=0)&(ny<H)&(nx>=0)&(nx<W)
    ids=base[valid];ny=ny[valid];nx=nx[valid]
    deg[ids]+=1
    dest=idx[ny,nx];inside=dest>=0
    rows.extend(ids[inside]);cols.extend(dest[inside]);vals.extend(-np.ones(inside.sum()))
    rhs[ids[~inside]]+=I[ny[~inside],nx[~inside]]
rows.extend(base);cols.extend(base);vals.extend(deg)
A=coo_matrix((vals,(rows,cols)),shape=(len(coords),len(coords))).tocsc()
solve=factorized(A)
BG=I.copy()
for c in range(3): BG[ys,xs,c]=solve(rhs[:,c])
del A,solve,rhs,rows,cols,vals

# Matte the tool and ball. Premultiplied colors preserve photographed edges.
tool_alpha=np.clip((BG[:,:,0]-I[:,:,0])/(BG[:,:,0]-9+1e-6),0,1)
tool_alpha=np.maximum(tool_alpha, np.clip((BG[:,:,1]-I[:,:,1])/(BG[:,:,1]-65+1e-6),0,1)*.8)
tool_alpha*=tool_gate
# All deeply interior tool pixels (including highlight details) are opaque.
inside_tool=(tool_gate>.98)&(I[:,:,0]<95)
tool_alpha[inside_tool]=1
TP=(I-BG*(1-tool_alpha[:,:,None]))
TP*=((tool_gate>.001)[:,:,None])
# Two pieces share a fixed small upper mounting region.
share=np.clip((653-X)/3+.5,0,1)
LA=tool_alpha*share;RA=tool_alpha*(1-share)
LP=TP*share[:,:,None];RP=TP*(1-share[:,:,None])

opaque_red=31+.25*(X-680)+9*np.maximum((X-680)/75,0)**2-.16*(Y-200)
opaque_red=np.clip(opaque_red,12,70)
BA=np.clip((BG[:,:,0]-I[:,:,0])/(BG[:,:,0]-opaque_red+1e-6),0,1)*ball_gate
BA=gaussian_filter(BA,.45)
# The pale curved seam is part of the ball, not a hole in its opacity.
core=((X-681)/68)**2+((Y-204)/62)**2<1
BA[core]=1
# Discard background noise but retain the genuine soft vertical silhouette.
BA=np.clip((BA-.008)/.992,0,1)
BP=I-BG*(1-BA[:,:,None])
BP=np.clip(BP,0,255*BA[:,:,None])
BP[BA==0]=0
# Original separate sources are cut down to small sprite regions for speed.
tbox=(518,0,799,201)
bbox=(588,99,778,307)
def crop(a,box):
    x0,y0,x1,y1=box;return a[y0:y1,x0:x1].copy()
LA,RA,LP,RP=[crop(a,tbox) for a in (LA,RA,LP,RP)]
BA,BP=crop(BA,bbox),crop(BP,bbox)

# Sand texture deformation stays local to the point of contact.
sbox=(425,402,934,650)
sx0,sy0,sx1,sy1=sbox
sy,sx=np.mgrid[sy0:sy1,sx0:sx1].astype(np.float32)
sand0=I[sy0:sy1,sx0:sx1].copy()
sg=np.clip((sand0[:,:,1]-sand0[:,:,0]-12)/35,0,1)*np.clip((sand0[:,:,1]-sand0[:,:,2]-10)/30,0,1)
qx=(sx-681)/98; qy=(sy-474)/53
rad=np.exp(-(qx*qx+qy*qy)*.8)
dxfield=10*qx*rad
dyfield=6*qy*rad+4*np.exp(-((sx-681)/88)**2-((sy-448)/35)**2)
# Minute irregularity in the foreground bank, drawn from source grain colors.
line_noise=gaussian_filter(rng.normal(0,1,509).astype(np.float32),1.1)*1.6

# A small set of cohesive, textured fragments, not a dust plume.
particles=[]
for j in range(19):
    side=-1 if j%2==0 else 1
    radius=rng.uniform(1.5,4.2)
    hh=int(np.ceil(radius*2+6));ww=hh
    py,px=np.mgrid[:hh,:ww].astype(np.float32)
    angle=np.arctan2(py-hh/2,px-ww/2)
    edge=radius*(1+.12*np.sin(angle*3+j)+.09*np.cos(angle*5+j*2))
    pm=np.clip(edge-np.sqrt((px-ww/2)**2+(py-hh/2)**2)+.5,0,1)
    tx=int(rng.integers(550,800));ty=int(rng.integers(485,555))
    color=I[ty:ty+hh,tx:tx+ww].copy()*rng.uniform(.9,1.08)
    vx=side*rng.uniform(95,185); vy=-rng.uniform(65,145)
    x=681+side*rng.uniform(58,76);y=rng.uniform(463,478)
    launch=rng.uniform(.01,.065)
    ground=rng.uniform(486,506)
    flight=(-vy+np.sqrt(vy*vy+2*950*(ground-y)))/950
    particles.append((pm,color,x,y,vx,vy,launch,ground,flight,side))


def bilinear(a, xx, yy):
    if a.ndim==2:
        return map_coordinates(a,[yy,xx],order=1,mode='constant',cval=0,prefilter=False)
    return np.stack([map_coordinates(a[:,:,c],[yy,xx],order=1,mode='constant',cval=0,prefilter=False) for c in range(a.shape[2])],-1)

def put_tool(canvas,alpha,premult,side,amount):
    x0,y0,x1,y1=tbox
    # Each jaw opens about the upper mounting; the top 28 px remain fixed.
    outx0=475;outx1=838;outy1=202
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[0:outy1,outx0:outx1].astype(np.float32)
    f=np.clip((yy-27)/161,0,1)
    off=side*amount*f**1.12
    source_x=xx-off-x0
    source_y=yy+.045*amount*f-y0
    aa=bilinear(alpha,source_x,source_y)
    pp=bilinear(premult,source_x,source_y)
    dst=canvas[:outy1,outx0:outx1]
    dst[:]=pp+dst*(1-aa[:,:,None])


def put_ball(canvas,cx,cy,angle):
    x0,y0,x1,y1=bbox
    # Bilinear rotation and translation of the source photographed fuzzy ball.
    left=int(cx-105);right=int(cx+105);top=int(cy-118);bottom=int(cy+119)
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[top:bottom,left:right].astype(np.float32)
    qx=xx-cx;qy=yy-cy
    ca=np.cos(angle);sa=np.sin(angle)
    xx=ca*qx+sa*qy+680-x0
    yy=-sa*qx+ca*qy+202-y0
    aa=bilinear(BA,xx,yy)
    pp=bilinear(BP,xx,yy)
    dst=canvas[top:bottom,left:right]
    dst[:]=pp+dst*(1-aa[:,:,None])


def put_particle(canvas,p,tau):
    mask,col,x,y,vx,vy,start,ground,flight,side=p
    age=tau-start
    if age<0:return
    if age<flight:
        xx=x+vx*age; yy=y+vy*age+475*age*age
        opacity=1.
    else:
        # Land quietly and stick to the cohesive sand surface.
        settle=age-flight
        xx=x+vx*flight+side*min(2.5,settle*20)
        yy=ground
        opacity=1.
    h,w=mask.shape
    ix=int(round(xx-w/2));iy=int(round(yy-h/2))
    if ix<0 or iy<0 or ix+w>W or iy+h>H:return
    a=mask*opacity
    # Small grounded contact shadow uses the same irregular shape.
    if age>=flight:
        dest=canvas[iy+1:iy+h+1,ix+1:ix+w+1]
        dest*=1-.13*a[:,:,None]
    dest=canvas[iy:iy+h,ix:ix+w]
    dest[:]=col*a[:,:,None]+dest*(1-a[:,:,None])

release=.47
g=1750.
impact_y=390.
impact_t=release+np.sqrt(2*(impact_y-202)/g)
frames=np.empty((N,H,W,3),np.uint8)
print('Source mattes:', 'ball alpha area',float(BA.sum()),'tool alpha area',float(LA.sum()+RA.sum()), 'impact time',impact_t,flush=True)
for k in range(N):
    t=k/FPS
    if t<=.20833334:
        frames[k]=I.astype(np.uint8)
        continue
    # Gradual opening, constant camera, no tool translation as a whole.
    opening=np.clip((t-.21)/.42,0,1)
    opening=opening*opening*(3-2*opening)
    amount=28*opening
    tau=max(t-impact_t,0)
    if t<release:
        cx=680.;cy=202.;angle=0.
    elif t<impact_t:
        dt=t-release
        cy=202+.5*g*dt*dt
        cx=680+2*dt
        angle=.12*dt
    else:
        # Highly damped landing into kinetic sand: energy is dissipated,
        # with no unrealistically elastic trampoline or repeated bouncing.
        cy=impact_y+28*(1-np.exp(-15*tau))+4.2*np.exp(-12*tau)*np.sin(20*tau)
        cx=681+1.4*(1-np.exp(-7*tau))
        angle=.055+.025*(1-np.exp(-9*tau))
    settle=1-np.exp(-17*tau) if tau>0 else 0.
    canvas=BG.copy()
    # Opened suspended blue-black tool.
    put_tool(canvas,LA,LP,-1,amount)
    put_tool(canvas,RA,RP,1,amount*.82)
    # Sand gradually yields around the ball's impact; source grain is warped.
    warped=np.stack([map_coordinates(I[:,:,c],[sy-dyfield*settle,sx-dxfield*settle],order=1,mode='nearest',prefilter=False) for c in range(3)],-1)
    # Surface shading describes the very shallow, plastically deformed basin.
    bowl=np.exp(-((sx-681)/70)**2-((sy-465)/29)**2)
    rim=np.exp(-((np.sqrt(((sx-681)/83)**2+((sy-477)/37)**2)-1)/.16)**2)
    warped*=1+settle*(-.09*bowl+.035*rim)[:,:,None]*sg[:,:,None]
    canvas[sy0:sy1,sx0:sx1]=warped
    # The cast shadow sharpens and darkens as the sphere approaches the sand.
    near=np.clip((cy-250)/140,0,1)
    shx=49+17*near;shy=15+3*near
    shadow=np.exp(-(((sx-(cx-17))/shx)**2+((sy-475)/shy)**2)*1.4)
    shadow*=sg*(.025+.18*near)
    canvas[sy0:sy1,sx0:sx1]*=1-shadow[:,:,None]
    # Some fragments are behind the ball; nearer ones are composited later.
    if tau>0:
        for p in particles[:10]:put_particle(canvas,p,tau)
    put_ball(canvas,cx,cy,angle)
    if tau>0:
        # Foreground bank covers just the buried lower cap. Its grainy edge
        # and uneven lip are taken from the original sand color structure.
        q=(sx-cx)/72
        arch=np.sqrt(np.clip(1-q*q,0,1))
        line=467+17*settle+4*arch+line_noise[None,:]
        front=np.clip((sy-line+.35)/1.4,0,1)
        front*=np.clip((74-np.abs(sx-cx))/4,0,1)*settle
        front*=sg
        strip=np.exp(-((sy-line-1.5)/2.7)**2)
        material=warped*(1+(.045*strip-.045*np.exp(-((sy-line-4)/2)**2))[:,:,None])
        dst=canvas[sy0:sy1,sx0:sx1]
        dst[:]=material*front[:,:,None]+dst*(1-front[:,:,None])
        for p in particles[10:]:put_particle(canvas,p,tau)
    frames[k]=np.clip(np.rint(canvas),0,255).astype(np.uint8)
    if k%24==0:print('Rendered',k,'ball',round(cx,2),round(cy,2),flush=True)
# Mandatory original RGB frame, with no conversions affecting its pixel values.
frames[0]=np.asarray(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
print('Saved',frames.shape,'to',ROOT,flush=True)
